deviations.reason: literature-normalize-authors.sh's --apply correctly converted all 60 string-valued authors fields to arrays, but mis-split 5 of the 60 (hughes_1996, hughes_1996_p00-p03) into a single-element array wrapping BOTH authors ('G. E. Hughes, M. J. Cresswell' as one array element) instead of splitting on the comma into two elements -- a splitting-heuristic edge case for the 'Initial. Initial. Lastname, Initial. Initial. Lastname' author-string shape. Manually corrected these 5 entries' authors field to ['G. E. Hughes', 'M. J. Cresswell'] post-apply, so the phase's own verification criterion ('zero array-valued authors entries contain an element with an embedded ", " join') holds. Total entries touched remains 60 (all still within the authors field only) -- the manual fix supplements the same 5 entries the script already touched, it does not add new entries to the changed set.
